title: Kenyan Cheesecake Trio
community: Urban Kenya — the hotel dessert menu signature
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Cheesecake Trio — three mini no-bake cheesecakes on individual biscuit bases: passion fruit, mango, and coffee. The hotel dessert menu's most photographed dish — three flavours representing Kenya's greatest produce on one plate.
longDesc: The cheesecake trio is the hotel restaurant's way of celebrating Kenya's greatest flavours simultaneously — passion fruit, mango, and coffee, each in a mini cheesecake, each representing something extraordinary about what this country produces. Served side by side on one plate, it is both beautiful and delicious.
ingredients: 3 tsp gelatin dissolved in 3 tbsp water
steps: Divide biscuit mixture into 12 small ring moulds. Press firmly. Refrigerate.
Beat cream cheese and sugar. Whip cream to soft peaks. Fold together with dissolved gelatin.
Divide cream cheese mixture into three equal portions.
Flavour each: passion fruit, mango, or coffee. Mix well.
Spoon into the prepared moulds — 4 of each flavour.
To serve: push out of moulds. Top passion fruit with pulp, mango with coulis, coffee with cocoa.
chefTips: Make the night before — the flavours develop beautifully overnight.
Line moulds with acetate strips for perfect release.
Arrange on the plate with deliberate colour contrast — orange, yellow, brown.
commonMistakes: Not enough gelatin — collapses when unmoulded.
Poor release — not lining with acetate.
cookingScience: See KEN234 for cheesecake setting science. In individual portions, the gelatin concentration is particularly critical — too little and they collapse; too much and the texture becomes rubbery. The ideal is a dessert that holds its shape while still feeling creamy on the palate.
sustainabilityTips: Three Kenyan agricultural products in one dessert — coffee, passion fruit, and mango — all locally grown.
healthBenefits: Passion fruit, mango, and coffee all provide antioxidants.
Best enjoyed as a celebration dessert.
culturalNote: The cheesecake trio is a love letter to Kenya's greatest produce — an elegant restaurant dessert that tells the story of Kenyan coffee, passion fruit, and mango in a single, beautiful plate.
